rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: routes/safety.py was using require_admin (Admin/PM only) on 8 GET endpoints (4 list + 4 detail). Safety reviewers got 401 'Admin or PM login required' toasts when opening Incidents, Audits & Inspections, Meetings, or JHAs from /safety-portal. FIX: introduced make_require_safety_admin_or_pm() in routes/safety_portal/_deps.py which accepts X-Safety-Token alongside X-Admin-Token / X-PM-Token, returning 401 'Safety, Admin, or PM login required' on miss. routes/safety.py.register_safety_routes() now wires this read-gate dep on list_incidents/inspections/meetings/jhas + their get_* counterparts. DELETE handlers untouched (still require_admin). Frontend: 3 detail routes wrapped in new RequireAdminPmOrSafety guard. REPRODUCTION (now confirmed fixed): (1) Bootstrap Safety token via admin reset · (2) curl /api/incidents with X-Safety-Token → 200 (was 401) · (3) UI: sign in as Safety → /safety-portal → click 'Incidents & Near Misses' → page loads with 41/41 incidents · (4) click Open on any row → /admin/incidents/{id} renders the Accident Report (was bounced to AccessDenied).
